scenes.event: Wedding planning meeting at a local café
scenes.description: Ruby Brooks, a 30-year-old bride and project planner, sits at a corner table with her mother and friend Sara, discussing the final guest list for her upcoming wedding. The atmosphere is warm but tense, as Ruby wrestles with the decision of whether to include her online friends.

actions.dialogue: I really want to include my online friends, but I’m worried they won’t be able to make it. What if it’s too much to ask?

actions.action: Reassures Ruby with a gentle tone
actions.dialogue: Sweetheart, it’s important to invite those who have been meaningful to you. If they can’t come, it’s not your fault. But if they can, they’ll feel honored to be included.
I get where you’re coming from, Ruby. But let’s be realistic—most of these people live in other countries or have busy lives. It might complicate your seating and budget if they don’t show up.
I know it’s a logistical challenge, but I’ve shared so much with them over the years. They’ve been through my ups and downs, just like in-person friends.
What if you invite a few of the closest ones? That way, you honor their presence without overextending yourself.
That sounds like a good plan. You can also send a note explaining that you’re inviting them because they mean a lot to you, but you understand if they can’t attend.
Maybe that’s the way to go. I just don’t want to make anyone feel like they’re not part of this important day.

scenes.plot: Ruby Brooks is trying to finalize her wedding guest list and is conflicted about whether to invite her online friends. Her mother encourages her to include them for emotional value, while her friend Sara urges her to consider practicality. Through their discussion, Ruby is guided toward a balanced decision that respects both her feelings and the realities of event planning.
scenes.social_purpose: This scene explores the tension between digital and real-world relationships, showcasing Ruby’s empathetic and thoughtful nature as she seeks to honor her online friends while managing the practical aspects of her wedding.
